All key citations verified against real files. I have enough to emit the report.

# 14 — Web-Client State Coverage vs. the Bot's Read Surface

## Method & scope

I enumerated **every** `TryGet*/Get*/Read*/Is*/Has*` read on `RynthCoreHost` (`/home/wbterminal/ac-refs/rynthcore/src/RynthCore.PluginSdk/RynthCoreHost.cs`, spot-verified line-by-line above), then mapped each to holtburger-web across three exposure vehicles:

1. **wasm getter** — a `#[wasm_bindgen] pub fn` on `SessionHandle` in `apps/holtburger-web/src/lib.rs` (55,502 lines; verified 17 core getters by name+line).
2. **JS entityMap / window globals** — `scene3d/entities.js`, `index.html`, proven by `k1_drive_combat.cjs`.
3. **crate-tracked struct field** — `crates/holtburger-world/src/entity.rs` `Entity`, `crates/holtburger-world/src/player/types.rs` `PlayerState`, `crates/holtburger-world/src/state/*` (`server_time`, `trade`, `fellowship`), no getter yet.

**Status legend:** `EXPOSED` = readable today from JS or wasm · `TRACKED-NOT-EXPOSED` = field lives in a session/world struct but no getter · `PARSED-NOT-TRACKED` = wire message decoded but discarded · `NOT-TRACKED` = never parsed/stored.

**Key architectural finding (verified):** holtburger-web has **two disjoint read planes**. Live per-*object* state (position, name, wcid, physics state, motion) flows JS-only via `poll_entity_updates()` (lib.rs:29246) → `entityMap`; it is largely **not** reachable through a `SessionHandle` getter. Per-*player/session* state (vitals, spells, enchantments, inventory, trade, fellowship, vendor) flows through **wasm snapshot getters**. A ported RynthAi brain that assumes one uniform `objectId`-keyed host (as `RynthCoreHost` is) must bridge both planes.

## Ranked build backlog — "what to add to holtburger-web"

Ranked by **(RynthAi dependency × implementation ease)**. Effort: **S** = getter over an existing field (<½ day) · **M** = new tracking/counter/event wiring (½–2 days) · **L** = structural.

| # | Item | Why RynthAi needs it | Backing exists? | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **`server_time()` wasm getter** | enchant/spell expiry, cooldowns, all timers reference `GetServerTime` | ✅ `WorldState.server_time` state/types.rs:58 + `current_server_time()` | **S** |
| 2 | **`player_guid()` wasm getter** | every objectId-keyed self check; wasm parity with JS | ✅ `PlayerState.guid` player/types.rs:1289 (JS has it) | **S** |
| 3 | **`combat_mode()` getter** (or promote `motion_stance()`) | combat FSM gates on mode | ✅ `motion_stance()` lib.rs:23253 / stance FSM | **S** |
| 4 | **`is_player_ready()` getter** | RynthAi won't act until ready; 344 `Has*` guards | ✅ `current_substate` player/types.rs:1466 | **S** |
| 5 | **`get_busy_state()` + `get_use_done_seq()` + `get_cast_busy_state()`** | **the poll-vs-async core** — RynthAi polls these each tick to sequence Use/cast/move actions | ⚠️ partial: sequence counters player/types.rs:1301-1333, `note_local_cast_window` setter lib.rs:32278; **no busy/use-done counter** | **M** (needs event-driven counters synthesized from Use-done / cast-done wire events) |
| 6 | **Typed per-object property getters** `object_{int,bool,quad,double,string,dataid}_property(guid,stype)` | RynthAi reads dozens of stypes per object; today only a JSON appraisal blob for ID'd objects | ✅ `Entity.properties:WorldObjectProperties` entity.rs:900 | **M** |
| 7 | **Appraisal-cache duo: `has_appraisal_data(guid)` + `get_last_id_time(guid)`** | RynthAi throttles re-ID and gates loot decisions on ID freshness | ⚠️ `latest_appraisals` cache exists (lib.rs:33976); **no id timestamp anywhere** — must stamp on identify apply (identify.rs) | **M** |
| 8 | **`object_motion_on(guid)` + `object_physics_state(guid)` + `object_state(guid)` getters** | movement/leash/attack sequencing needs per-mob motion & physics state on the wasm plane | ✅ `Entity.motion_snapshot` entity.rs:895, `physics_state` entity.rs:892 (JS has physicsState) | **S** |
| 9 | **Synchronous `target_vitals(guid)` getter** (return cached `health_fraction`) | RynthAi polls target HP; today only async `query_health` + event | ✅ `Entity.health_fraction` entity.rs:896 | **S** |
| 10 | **`object_name(guid)` / `object_wcid(guid)` wasm getters** | port that assumes a uniform host can't reach JS `entityMap`; bridge object identity to wasm plane | ✅ `Entity.name`/`wcid` entity.rs:881 | **S** |
| 11 | **`object_wielder_info(guid)` / `object_ownership_info(guid)`** | container/equip logic (loot, salvage, give) | ⚠️ derive from `Entity.properties` / wielder index (partial via lib.rs:29906/29958) | **M** |
| 12 | **`vitae()` penalty getter** | death-recovery decisions | ⚠️ `PARSED-NOT-TRACKED` — only `vitae_spell_id()` lib.rs:26327 | **M** |
| 13 | **`is_portaling()` flag** | suppress actions mid-portal | ❌ not tracked — add flag on portal-out/in wire events | **M** |
| 14 | **`selected_item_id()` wasm getter + previous-selection tracking** | selection-driven Use/attack; RynthAi reads both current & previous | ⚠️ JS `_selectedGuid` entities.js:6648; **no "previous"** | **S** |
| 15 | **`ground_container_id()`** | drop-to-ground / pickup flows | ❌ not tracked | **S** |
| 16 | **Container count getters** `num_contained_items/containers(guid)` | inventory-management convenience | ✅ derive from `get_container_contents()` lib.rs:30211 | **S** |
| 17 | **`object_heading_degrees(guid)` convenience** | facing checks without JS quaternion math | ✅ `Entity.position` quat entity.rs:882 | **S** |

**Deepest structural risk (confirms established facts):** items **#5** (busy/use-done/cast-busy) are the concrete manifestation of the poll-vs-async inversion. `RynthCoreHost` exposes these as synchronous counters a host-pumped tick reads every frame; holtburger-web has **no equivalent** — cast/use completion is event-driven (`_castBusyUntilMs` is a JS-side timeout heuristic, entities.js:7230, not a server-authoritative counter). Building these three requires deciding where the RynthAi tick pumps and how completion events increment counters — this is the one backlog cluster that is design work, not a getter.

**Coverage summary:** Of ~56 `RynthCoreHost` reads, ~**24 EXPOSED** (12 wasm getter, 12 JS-plane), ~**11 TRACKED-NOT-EXPOSED** (field exists, add getter), ~**8 NOT-TRACKED/NOT-EXPOSED** (real build work: vitae, last-id-time, busy/use-done/cast-busy, is-portaling, ground-container), ~**6 host-internal/render** N/A, remainder PARTIAL. The bulk of the backlog is cheap getters over already-tracked struct fields; the genuine engineering is the busy/sequence trio (#5) and the identify-timestamp cache (#7).
